name: contextnest
description: Vault-aware context retrieval and automatic knowledge capture, powered by the Context Nest `ctx` CLI.

retrieval_mode.title: Retrieval effort
retrieval_mode.description: How much context to auto-inject on each prompt: off | search (cheap full-text) | query (graph) | agent (full reasoning).

auto_capture.title: Auto-capture knowledge
auto_capture.description: At the end of a substantive turn, trigger the capture agent to persist new facts/decisions into the vault.

vault.title: Pinned vault alias
vault.description: Always use this registered vault. Leave empty to let the agents pick the relevant vault(s) automatically.

ctx_command.title: ctx binary
ctx_command.description: Command used to invoke the Context Nest CLI. Falls back to `npx -y @promptowl/contextnest-cli` if not found.
